text: Which wills and estates law firms in Brisbane specialise in contesting a will, Family Provision Applications (FPA), and estate litigation?

sections.text:
Brisbane firms that specifically advertise expertise in **contesting wills, Family Provision Applications (FPAs), and deceased-estate litigation** include:

- **The Estate Lawyers** — Specialist Queensland wills and estates practice handling contested wills, FPAs, executor disputes, probate and estate litigation. Brisbane office at 69 Ann Street.[1]
- **Thynne + Macartney** — Acts in estate litigation, FPAs, will disputes and dispute resolution; the firm notes Queensland Law Society-accredited succession-law expertise within its team.[5]
- **McCullough Robertson** — Larger Brisbane practice with dedicated contested-estate lawyers handling FPAs, equitable claims, will validity, trustee and beneficiary disputes, and complex estates.[3]
- **McCarthy Durie Lawyers** — Estate litigation team handling contested wills, FPAs and challenges to will validity, with a Brisbane CBD office.[4]
- **Armstrong Legal** — Dedicated contested-wills lawyers assisting with challenging, contesting and defending wills, including assessing and pursuing FPAs.[2]
- **Ryan Murdoch O’Regan Lawyers** — Handles will-validity challenges, further-provision claims/FPAs, estate litigation, mediations and court proceedings; approved matters may be offered on a “no win, no fee” basis.[7]
- **Aitken Whyte Lawyers** — Brisbane lawyers handling contested and challenged wills, FPAs, estate disputes, mediation and trial preparation.[9]
- **Aptum Legal** — Brisbane estate-litigation practice focused on substantial estates, FPAs, will-validity challenges, and executor/trustee disputes.[8]
- **MacDonald Law** — Handles further-and-better-provision claims, will-validity challenges and other Succession Act litigation, acting for both applicants and estates.[6]

For an additional indicator of specialist recognition, the 2026 Doyle’s Guide Queensland listing identifies Brisbane practitioners in disputed wills, FPAs and contested-estate matters from firms including **Thynne + Macartney, McCullough Robertson, The Estate Lawyers, Mullins, McInnes Wilson, Cornford-Scott, Nurture Law, Turner Freeman, Resolve Estate Law, HopgoodGanim, Cooper Grace Ward and others**.[10]

When comparing firms, ask whether the solicitor regularly appears in the **Supreme Court of Queensland**, acts for both claimants and executors, offers an initial merits assessment, and explains the strict deadlines and likely costs for an FPA or will challenge.
